item.description: The area where four states meet in the U.S. Southwest remains on a flood watch after days of heavy rain and winds.

item.title: Loggers say Roadless Rule repeal won't solve their biggest challenges
item.description: President Trump is planning to open up some of the nation's last pristine forests to road building and timber companies. But those who work in the woods say it won't do enough to revive the industry.

item.description: A federal judge struck down a Trump administration ban on issuing immigrant visas to people from 75 countries, but immigrants continue to be stuck in their countries.

item.title: Republicans are spending millions and still may not win districts drawn to favor them
item.description: Republicans redrew Congressional district lines to try to tilt the midterms in their favor. But now they are facing expensive and competitive races they had hoped to outmaneuver.

item.title: An inside look of the massive data center tearing a Wisconsin community apart
item.description: In Port Washington, Wisconsin, there's a data center being built that's as big as 500 football fields. Residents aren't sure if it could save their community or destroy it.

item.title: Why Wisconsin's tight governor's race matters
item.description: The close race for governor in Wisconsin is being watched to see how a candidate back by President Trump does in a state where rural voters have sometimes swung from one party the other.
